title: Picou's arrangements and the advertising number
summary: Picou was great to work with and arranged special numbers like Get Busy Rag for their wagon advertising.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: How was Piku to work with?
Oh, he was just great. He was a great old man. He showed me a whole lot of what I know. I mean, as far as that, I mean different things.
He helped you with his music and all.
He helped me, nice to me.

He helped the whole band in other words. He did. He arranged some different numbers for us. We had some numbers that nobody could play to, because when he would get it, he said, don't give it to nobody. We had to know that we used to play on the advertising and we was the only one playing on the advertising. So you name it Get Busy Rag. Get Busy Rag.

We was the only one playing the trammone at the last thing. Ike Rawson was playing trammone at that time. Ike was the only one know of that too, because don't you give that to nobody? Nobody ever did get that music.
